definitions.explanation: A clear Japanese soup made with dashi and typically containing a few refined ingredients. Distinguished from miso soup by its clear, delicate broth.

{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{吸|す}い{物|もの} (literally "thing to sip") is a refined clear soup in Japanese cuisine.

Characteristics:
- Clear, transparent broth
- Delicate, subtle flavor
- Few, high-quality ingredients
- Served in lacquered bowls with lids

Typical ingredients (⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧=ingredients, ⟦{椀種|わんだね}→椀種：noentry⟧):
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ (tofu)
- ⟦{麩|ふ}→麩：24202_fu⟧ (wheat gluten)
- ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧ (shrimp)
- ⟦{蛤|はまぐり}→ハマグリ：23183_hamaguri⟧ (clam) - traditional for Girls' Day
- Seasonal vegetables
- ⟦{吸|す}い{口|くち}→吸い口：noentry⟧ (aromatic garnish like ⟦{木|き}の{芽|め}→木の芽：noentry⟧)

Differs from ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧:
- {吸|す}い{物|もの} = clear broth, more formal
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ = miso-based, everyday

Part of traditional Japanese meal structure.
